messages:
Asha (AE): Heads up — Sable Systems asking for a special pilot package: 33% off first 60 days + net60. Pilot 60 days, potential 12mo conversion. PO incoming.
Leo (DealDesk): 33% is high. Need estimated pilot spend, conversion ARR, and whether partner discounts apply.
Asha (AE): Pilot list = $22k. If convert, ARR ~85k. They want runway due to slow procurement.
Nina (Finance Ops): Policy: finance can approve up to 25% one-time pilot concession. Net60 increases DSO; AR must sign off. Suggest 25% + $2k onboarding credit as alternative.
Leo (DealDesk): Can we offer 25% + $2k and a conditional 8% conversion bonus if they sign 12mo within 30 days? Keeps structure clean.
Asha (AE): Customer prefers 33% flat. They are offering a signed conversion term sheet before pilot start if we grant net60.
Omar (Legal): If we accept net60, we need clawback language: credits will be invoiced if conversion doesn't execute within 90 days of pilot. Also need counterparty guarantee if net60. I can draft.
Nina (Finance Ops): Approvals: any concession >25% requires CFO approval. Net60 requires AR collateral or guarantee. We can flag billing to manual until docs clear.
Ruth (CFO): I will approve up to 30% one-time pilot credit if and only if: 1) signed conversion term sheet before pilot, 2) PO received, 3) Legal clawback clause included, 4) AR places account on hold until first invoice paid Net30. Net60 only after conversion signed.
Asha (AE): Noted — will ask Sable for signed term sheet and PO. They said they'd provide guarantee if needed.
Omar (Legal): Drafted clause link: //legal/sable-clawback-v1. Will add guarantee template.
BillingBot: Account SABLE-009 flagged. HOLD applied: MANUAL_BILLING_FLAG.
Leo (DealDesk): Summary: Ask approved conditionally per CFO. Finance to track exposure; DealDesk to confirm conversion bonus if signed.
Ruth (CFO): Confirmed. No extra margin concessions without return to CFO.
Asha (AE): Thanks everyone. Moving to ops and attaching documents when received. :white_check_mark:
